user.title: Set up Mail Package Tracker
user.description: Connect your email inbox via IMAP (uses `SINCE` date filter and `BODY.PEEK[]` so unread emails are **never** marked as read) or listen to Home Assistant `imap_content` events.

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to IMAP server. Please verify credentials and folder.

abort.already_configured: Mail Package Tracker is already configured.

menu_options.rule_from_email: 📧 Create / Edit Rule from Email (Mail Assistant)

rule_from_email.title: 📧 Step 1: Select an Email from Inbox
rule_from_email.description: Select one of the recently fetched emails. On the next screen, the full email text is displayed so you can copy-paste phrases directly into your filter rules.

no_emails_found.title: No Emails Cached Yet
no_emails_found.description: No emails have been fetched yet. Click Submit to create a rule manually or verify your IMAP settings.

configure_rule_from_email.title: 📧 Step 2: Copy Passages & Save Rule
configure_rule_from_email.description: Copy keywords from the **Email Preview** box into the filter fields below (one pattern per line or comma-separated, case-insensitive).

manage_carriers.title: 🚚 Manage Carriers & Shops
manage_carriers.description: Select a carrier/shop rule to edit or delete.

edit_carrier.title: 🚚 Edit Filter Rules
edit_carrier.description: One keyword per line or comma-separated (case-insensitive).

data.name: Carrier / Shop Name
data.tracking_regex: Filter for Tracking / Order Number (Prefix or Regex)
data.content_regex: Filter for Package Content (Header or Regex)
data.tracking_url_regex: Filter for Tracking URL (Keywords or Regex)

add_carrier.title: ➕ Add New Carrier / Shop
add_carrier.description: Creates a new Carrier Device with custom filter rules.

data.name: Carrier / Shop Name
data.tracking_regex: Filter for Tracking / Order Number (Prefix or Regex)
data.content_regex: Filter for Package Content (Header or Regex)

test_email.title: 🧪 Live Rule Tester
test_email.description: Test your rules against sample email content. Check 'Finish' to close.

general_settings.title: ⚙️ General & IMAP Settings
general_settings.description: Adjust IMAP credentials, lookback days, and auto-cleanup.
